blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are like terms of four x y? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the like terms of 4xy.

blocks.text: Negative two x y. Same variable part, x y. A like term.
y x. Multiplication is commutative, so y x is x y. A like term, with coefficient one.
Four x. It has x, but no y. Not a like term.
Four x squared y. The x is squared here, so the variable part is different. Not a like term.
Nine y. It has y, but no x. Not a like term.
Two of them are like terms of four x y: negative two x y, and y x. Each has one x and one y, and the order of a product doesn't matter.
